title: CFB Top Picks Research + Completeness V2 — Step 5 defense + pace research
project: CFB Top Picks Research + Completeness V2
problem: Top Picks had verified offensive scoring research but still lacked opponent defensive allowance and tempo/pace evidence behind the matchup.
root_cause: The selected-game detail payload did not route existing certified ESPN/NCAA defense and pace fields into a read-only Top Picks research layer.
patch: Add a descriptive field router for points allowed, recent allowance, yards/play allowed, pass/rush allowance, red-zone defense, explosive-efficiency susceptibility, plays/game, seconds/play and same-division pace index. Render it only after a matchup is tapped.
